items.name: Hannah Jumbo Cord Corner Sofa With Pouffe/Footstool
items.description:
Darcey Jumbo Cord Corner Sofa with Pouffe Footstool
Upgrade your living room with the Darcey Jumbo Cord Corner Sofa with Pouffe Footstool. Designed for modern family living, this spacious corner sofa combines comfort, practicality, and contemporary style in one cosy design. In addition, the soft jumbo cord fabric and supportive seating create the perfect place to relax every day.

Soft Jumbo Cord Fabric
Upholstered in soft and hard-wearing jumbo cord fabric, this jumbo cord corner sofa feels warm, cosy, and inviting. Moreover, the textured corduroy upholstery adds softness and comfort while giving your living room a stylish modern look. The sofa is also available in Grey, Coffee, Chocolate, Black, and Mink colours to suit different interior styles.

Spacious Family Seating
The large corner sofa design offers generous seating space for up to four people. Furthermore, the deep seat cushions and plush foam filling help provide lasting comfort throughout the day. Whether you are entertaining guests, watching films, or relaxing with family, this family corner sofa creates the perfect place to unwind.

Comfortable Scatter Back Cushions
This scatter back corner sofa includes supportive back cushions and scatter cushions for added comfort. In addition, the soft cushions help create a relaxed and cosy seating experience for everyday use. The web suspension system also provides firm and reliable support while helping maintain comfort over time.

Matching Pouffe Footstool
The matching pouffe footstool adds extra comfort and flexibility to your living space. Moreover, the footstool can be used for stretching out, extra seating, or as a practical finishing touch for your lounge area. As a result, this corner sofa with footstool is ideal for both relaxing and entertaining.

Built for Everyday Living
Crafted with a strong wooden frame, this modern corner sofa is designed for durability and everyday family use. Furthermore, the removable seat covers help make cleaning and maintenance easier for busy households. Assembly is also simple, requiring only the attachment of the clips.

Key Features
1. Jumbo cord corner sofa

2. Soft and durable corduroy upholstery

3. Matching pouffe footstool included

4. Spacious seating for up to four people

5. Deep foam-filled seat cushions

6. Comfortable scatter back cushions

7. Strong wooden frame construction

8. Web suspension for firm support

Available in Grey, Coffee, Chocolate, Black, and More

Corner Sofa Dimensions
Width: 212cm x 164cm
Height: 78cm
Depth: 87cm
Seat Depth: 49cm

Footstool Dimensions
Width: 60cm
Depth: 60cm
Height: 40cm

Bring comfort and modern style into your home with the Darcey Jumbo Cord Corner Sofa with Pouffe Footstool. Spacious, stylish, and practical, it is the perfect choice for family living.
